title: D-024 Amendment 40 model-selection: owner-commanded thematic subagent model/effort switch; main pin Fable 5.1 high, fallback claude-opus-4-8 xhigh
objective: Implement the Amendment-40 standing model-selection policy (R599-R606) AFTER the owner resolves the recorded decision rows R603/R604/R605: an owner command that thematically switches ALL subagent effort/model selections at once (explicit alias table; refuse unknown words) without touching the main/orchestrator pin; main pin Fable 5.1 (runtime id claude-fable-5-1, R602) at effort high; fallback claude-opus-4-8 xhigh via the existing turnover path. Depends on owner-only protected-config allowlist + KNOWN_MODEL_TIERS edits (R606). Backlog until the owner decisions land; not part of the Tranche-B workflow.
business_reason: Owner directive D-024 Amendment 40 #model-selection (R599-R606). Qualifying evidence: D-024-R601.
inputs: Owner decisions on D-024-R603 ('ultra' alias), R604 (fallback-effort mechanism), R605 (main pin literal + effortLevel handling) — REQUIRED before claim
Owner-only: claude-fable-5-1 added to the protected supervisor config allowlist (D-010-R297) and to tools/model_routing.py KNOWN_MODEL_TIERS (R606)
outputs: tools/agent_model_switch.py + tools/test_agent_model_switch.py (thematic subagent switch with explicit alias table; refuses unknown words; never touches the main pin)
.claude/agents/*.md effort/model updates applied uniformly by the command
.claude/skills/model-switch/SKILL.md (owner-facing command) + docs/MODEL_SELECTION_POLICY.md (standing policy: main Fable 5.1 high; fallback claude-opus-4-8 xhigh)
acceptance_scenarios: AS-1 (R601): one command switches every subagent definition's effort (and model where stated) uniformly; a diff shows only .claude/agents/** changed and the orchestrator/main pin untouched.
AS-2 (R603): the alias table is explicit (e.g. ultra -> xhigh only if the owner confirms) and an unknown word is refused with a non-zero exit (paired negative test).

AS-3 (R599/R600/R602/R605): the main pin resolves to the runtime-verified id claude-fable-5-1 at effort high and the fallback to claude-opus-4-8 xhigh, exactly as the owner decided on R604/R605; validate_mcp_policy stays green.
AS-4 (R606): claim is refused until the owner-only allowlist/tier edits exist (documented preflight check).
risks: Conflicts with D-004 R734/R741/R742 and D-010 R286/R297 are recorded as owner-decision rows; implementing before the owner decides would be silent interpretation (prohibited).
